about.bio: I'm Hake Acc — a dedicated Social Media Manager, Discord Server Developer, and Creator Agency Founder with 5+ years of experience helping high-profile YouTubers scale their audience, retention, and community. From viral content packaging and video SEO to custom Discord bot ecosystems and full channel management, I build systems that turn viewers into lifelong superfans.
